text: Operator opened bypass instead of block valve on IA receiver V-5104. pressure low alarm on the transmitter ackd, board optr opened bypass to restore flow; the SIF not demanded.
Outelt line plugged with solids, no flow from CW pump P-5103A. BPCS and operator response held flow below trip setpoint; SIF50030 did not act. No pump trip recorded.
sif-60-018 trpd with no process demand. impulse line of U60-LT-6018 plugged, reading false. Restarted after 18 hrs.
Process deviation, root cause not yet recorded. BPCS and optr response held lvl below trip setpoint; sif-60-021 did not act.
SIF60035 tripped with no process demand. loose terminal on u60-pt-6035 loop wiring, no process deviation. Restarted after 2 hrs. Control vlv stroke checked OK.
Operator opened bypass instead of block valve on reactor effluent cooler E-2103. ESD on reactor effluent cooler E-2103: U20 PT-2037 pressure lo trip, the SIF worked, unit brought to safe state.
Machine stopped unexpectedly. the SIF trip on pr hi (the transmitter reached trip setpoint), boiler B-5102 shut down safely.

MOTOR TRIPPED ON EARTH FAULT, FLOW TO COMPRESSOR K-4101 LOST. ALARM U40-TT-4003 TEMPERATURE HI CAME IN, OPR STARTED STBY PUMP AND PROCESS RECOVERED BEFORE TRIP. INSTRUMENT AIR PRESS WAS NORMAL THROUGHOUT.
Transmitter on U30-LIC-3038 loop froze, controller drove valve wide open. level low alarm on u30-lt-3038 ackd, board operator took the loop to manual and stabilised; sif-30-038 not demanded.
Pump mechanical seal failed, pump stopped by field operator. the SIF trip on pr high (the transmitter reached trip setpoint), reflux drum V-3104 shut down safely.
Unplanned shutdown of feed drum V-1101 by SIF 10-020; transmitter U10-LT-1020 found drifting, no real process upset. Unit restarted after 8 hrs. Control valve stroke checked OK.
Supply header disturbance hit the vessel. lvl lo trip: the SIF activated from the transmitter, final elements closed as designed.
Operator opened bypass instead of block vlv on reflux drum V-3104. BPCS and operator response held lvl below trip setpoint; SIF 30-013 did not act.
the SIF tripped with no process demand. trip solenoid failed de-energised, process was steady. Restarted after 6 hrs.
DOWNSTREAM BLOCK VLV FOUND CLOSED ON DISCHARGE DRUM V-4104 OUTLET. ALARM U40-PT-4010 PR LO CAME IN, OPR REDUCED FEED AND PROCESS RECOVERED BEFORE TRIP.
Motor tripped on earth fault, flow to steam drum V-5101 lost. flow lo alarm on U50-FT-5028 acknowledged, board optr reduced feed; SIF-50-028 not demanded. Instrument air press was normal throughout.
Fouled exchanger gave reduced cooling duty on reactor effluent cooler E-2103. Alarm U20-LT-2019 lvl high came in, operator reduced feed and process recovered before trip.
THE SIF TRIPPED WITH NO PROCESS DEMAND. TRIP SOLENOID FAILED DE-ENERGISED, PROCESS WAS STEADY. RESTARTED AFTER 6 HRS.

Running pump tripped on motor overload, stby did not autostart. SIF30030 tripped on pressure hi (U30-PT3030 reached trip setpoint), reflux drum V-3104 shut down safely. Instrument air pressure was normal throughout.
Outlet strainer choked on discharge drum V-4104. press low alarm on U40-PT-4026 ackd, board optr isolated the affected line; SIF-40-026 not demanded. Cooling water checked normal.
Controller output erratic on U60-PIC-6013. ESD on storage tank T-6102: U60-PT-6013 press high trip, the SIF worked, unit brought to safe state. Procedure followed as written.
U10-FIC-1012 loop misbehaving, valve hunting. flow low alarm on U10-FT-1012 acknowledged, board operator took the loop to manual and stabilised; SIF10012 not demanded.
column C-3102: Running pump trpd on motor overload, stby did not autostart. BPCS and opr response held pressure below trip setpoint; the SIF did not act.
BOOTSER PUMP COUPLING FAILURE, DISCHARGE FLOW COLLAPSED. TEMP HIGH TRIP: THE SIF ACTIVATED FROM U60-TT-6038, FINAL ELEMENTS CLOSED AS DESIGNED.
sif-50-038 trip with no process demand. trip solenoid failed de-energised, process was steady. Restarted after 2 hrs.
